visual.description: Very light warm off-white used as the main page background.
Near-black used for the Hermès Paris heading and body copy text.
Dark gray used for paragraph and instructional text.
White card/widget background for the verification challenge box.
Light gray used for borders on the verification widget and buttons.
Slightly darker off-white fill for the slider track and button backgrounds.
Blue highlight/selection color on the active image-mode icon button in the widget.
Muted gray used for the refresh/reload icon and secondary UI elements.
Blue hyperlink color used for the 'Submit feedback' link at the bottom.
